key_insight: An input skip can lower VAE reconstruction error without changing the generated distribution, so better reconstruction does not necessarily mean better generation.
engineering_relevance: Evaluate generative quality separately from reconstruction error when choosing skip connections or calibrating observation noise.
method: Show an exact Gaussian VAE reparameterization for constant skip α: scale decoder output by 1−α and noise variance by (1−α)².
Compare reconstruction MSE, energy score, and importance-sampled negative log-density estimates in a known-density Gaussian experiment.
Evaluate neural models on seven annual DART records and compare energy scores against PPCA.
evidence_signal: The Gaussian experiment reduced MSE while worsening generative metrics; DART skip effects varied by record, and PPCA achieved lower mean energy scores than every neural DART fit.
watch_item: The equivalence applies to matched reparameterizations; separately trained models can learn different generators because optimization depends on parameter coordinates.
paper_title: An Input Skip Can Reparameterize a VAE Without Improving the Generator
